method: Actual original and patched shared request helper from bundled MapLibre 5.6.2 in WorkerGlobalScope VM, with native Request/Response/AbortController and observed fetch/GR/XHR boundary doubles. Fetch scope and route logic are tested; no actual browser worker, CORS or pixel claim.

checks.name: Actual upstream WorkerScope forwards both blob:http and blob:https to main, while the precise patched helper fetches/parses them inside the worker
Ordinary HTTP and HTTPS fetch routes, Accept header and referrer are unchanged
Existing file URLs still select XHR instead of worker fetch or main dispatch
Registered custom protocols still invoke their local handler, including abort-controller identity
Unregistered custom protocols still forward GR with the same controller and global dispatcher
Native blob path carries the abort signal and refuses data aborted after body parsing
Blob fetch failures preserve MapLibre AJAXError status=0 and never retry through main
Invalid Blob JSON fails during worker parsing and 404 retains the normal error status
Without fetch support native Blob requests retain the existing queued main-thread compatibility fallback
